correctness.rationale: Exact rank-one projector algebra and Gaussian eigendecomposition reduce every error threshold to an expectation of the strictly convex chi-square-one survival function evaluated at a weighted sum of iid chi-square-one variables. Strict Jensen plus symmetry proves strict Schur-convexity; Cauchy/beta identities give exact endpoints. All 1,264 standalone numerical checks passed, with infinite statements independently proved algebraically.

value.rationale: For a natural covariance-design question in Gaussian randomized SVD, the theorem yields an exact fixed-marginal minimax covariance with strict first-order stochastic rather than just mean improvement, identifies dimension three as the first nontrivial instance, and gives explicit Cauchy/beta success laws. It shows why covariance trace and unit marginal variances alone do not determine accuracy.
